named_premises: Terminal Observer has the seven properties: Φ=∞, necessary existence, omnipresence, maximal coherence, source of all actuality, self-grounding, and voluntary/personal coupling.
God has the matching traditional divine attributes: omniscience, aseity, omnipresence, perfection, creator, uncaused cause, and personal/relational.
The physical and theological attributes are isomorphic (encoded as shared predicates).
Identity of indiscernibles: any two entities with the same listed properties are identical.
The encoding faithfully represents the intended domain; any formal-to-world identification needs an independently warranted bridge.
receipt: Terminal Observer is identical to God by property matching

obstructions.reason: The derivation stops at the move from P-IMAGO’s analogical resemblance to a specific quantum/IIT Terminal Observer; P-IMAGO explicitly does not yield physical laws, Φ=∞, empirical measurements, or identity of a creature with God.
